Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Eligibility Criteria/Terms and Condition The bidders must have their own shop in Andaman & Nicobar Islands (any relevant documentary evide nce must be submitted). Shop registration certificate/document. Self-attested copy of PAN card of the firm or proprietor/partner. Self-attested copy of GST registration, if applicable. Other documents, if any. The successful bidder shall submit a Performance Guarantee @ 5% of the total contract value in favour of the Assistant Commissioner(HQ)/DDO, Sub-Jail Mayabunder from any nationalized bank. within a period of 07 days from the date of acceptance of award communication made by this office. Terms & Conditions 1. The items should be supplied on the strength of the inmates lodged in the jail as per the requisition given by the storekeeper at main gate of the District Correctional Home, Mayabunder.

2. The bidder should carefully go through all the clauses and details indicated in the bid document before quo ting the rates. No excuse will be entertained later on. 3. The rate quoted by the firms for the items must be final inclusive of all taxes/ charges as applicable. 4. Revision of rates will not be allowed after opening of the bid. 5. The bidders should submit an EMD of 2% (if estimated amount is Rs. 5,00,000/- or more) of the estimated cost. The EMD must be submitted in an acceptable form, drawn in favour of the Assistant Commissioner(H Q)/DDO, Sub-Jail Mayabunder from any nationalized bank. 6. The successful bidder shall submit a Performance Guarantee @ 5% of the total contract value in favour of the Assistant Commissioner(HQ)/DDO, Sub-Jail Mayabunder from any nationalized bank. within a period of 07 days from the date of acceptance of award communication made by this office. 7. The validity period of the contract shall be 01 year. However, it may be extended for a further period of u p to 03 months or till finalization of the new bid, whichever is earliest. 8. It is the sole responsibility of the seller to deliver the items in good condition. If the items are found spoiled the same should be replaced immediately with fresh items by the supplier without any additional cost. 9. In case the suppliers fail to honour the commitment after acceptance of the contract this department has t he right to forfeit the performance security lying with this department. Further, the bidder shall not sub-let or entrust the work to any other agency. 10. The supplier shall submit the bills on the GeM portal in parts or in total. 11. Arbitration and Jurisdiction: Both the parties of the Agreement shall make every effort to resolve any di sagreement or dispute arising between the parties or in connection with the Agreement amicably at the fir st instant. In case of failure, all disputes, controversies or claim between parties shall be referred for arbitr ation to the sole arbitrator to be appointed by Hon’ble Lt. Governor, A&N Islands for the purpose. The arbit ration proceeding shall be held in accordance with the provisions of Arbitration and conciliation Act 1996. T he venue of arbitration shall be at Sri Vijaya Puram, A&N Islands. In the event of failure through arbitration , the same shall be settled with the jurisdiction of competent court at Sri Vijaya Puram, A&N Islands. .
